library(here)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Load libraries ----
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(magrittr)
library(viridis)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r}
# load results from all adrd models
pos_med_m1 <- read_rds(paste0("data/intermediate/adrd-m1_pos_med.rds"))
pos_med_m2 <- read_rds(paste0("data/intermediate/adrd-m2_pos_med.rds"))
pos_med_m3 <- read_rds(paste0("data/intermediate/adrd-m3_pos_med.rds"))

#--- select columns of interest and change column names to identify model

# columns of interest
cols_to_keep <- c("county", "risk_ratio")

pos_med_m1 %<>% 
  select(all_of(cols_to_keep)) %>%
  rename(risk_ratio_m1 = risk_ratio) %>%
  distinct()

pos_med_m2 %<>% 
  select(all_of(cols_to_keep)) %>%
  rename(risk_ratio_m2 = risk_ratio) %>%
  distinct()

pos_med_m3 %<>% 
  select(all_of(cols_to_keep)) %>%
  rename(risk_ratio_m3 = risk_ratio) %>%
  distinct()

# pos_med_m4 %<>% 
#   select(all_of(cols_to_keep)) %>%
#   rename(risk_ratio_m4 = risk_ratio,
#          risk_ratio_sig_m4 = risk_ratio_sig)


#--- merge for comparison
pos_med <- 
  merge(pos_med_m1, pos_med_m2,
        by = c("county")) %>%
  merge(pos_med_m3,
        by = c("county")) # %>%
  # merge(pos_med_m4,
  #       by = c("county", "race"))


#--- gather risk ratio columns
pos_med %<>%
  gather(key = "model", "risk_ratio", 
         paste0("risk_ratio_m", c(1:3)))
```


```{r}
# plot distributions of risk ratios
pos_med %>% 
  mutate(model = ifelse(model == "risk_ratio_m1", "Unadjusted", model),
         model = ifelse(model == "risk_ratio_m2", "Adjusted for PIR", model),
         model = ifelse(model == "risk_ratio_m3", "Adjusted for PM2.5", model)) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Unadjusted", "Adjusted for PIR", "Adjusted for PM2.5"))) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_density(aes(x = risk_ratio, col = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, lty = 2) +
  labs(x = "Risk Ratio (Black/White)",
       y = "Density",
       col = "") +
  theme_light() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
```
